SEAL SHOVE - a RetroStone VC game for Windows
(c) 2026 Pierre-Louis Boyer (8BCraft). Code MIT, art/music/sound CC BY-NC-SA 4.0: see LICENSE-sealshove.txt.

Four round seals in woolly hats on an ice floe, and only one may stay. Waddle
on the slippery ice, belly-slide into the others (A) and shove them into the
sea, while the floe cracks and chunks of it break off and drift away. The last
seal on the floe wins the round; first to 3 rounds wins the match. Grab the
fish that flop onto the ice: the blue one makes you heavy, the golden one
makes your next slide a mega slide. Alone, beat three bots, then smarter ones,
match after match: lose a match and it is game over. Medals at 100, 400, 750
and 1200 points, and your best is kept.

Run SealShove.exe. No installation needed (SDL2 is built in).

Controls                  Gamepad (SNES layout)      Keyboard
  waddle (8 directions)     D-pad                      arrow keys
  belly slide               A                          X
  start                     A (or Start, D-pad)        X or Enter
  pause / resume            Select (or Start in play)  Backspace or Esc
  players 2-4 join          A on their pad, on the title (B leaves)
  back to the title         A (or Select) on the results
  touch / mouse             a finger down on the left part and dragged: a
                            stick (waddle that way); the round DASH button at
                            the bottom right; a tap starts

Always four seals on the floe: up to four players (red, blue, green and
purple caps) with their own pads, and bots for the free places. Together you
play one match; the results rank you by the rounds you won.

F11 or Alt+Enter: fullscreen. F12: screenshot. Close the window to quit.
Options: SealShove.exe --scale 4 --fullscreen
The best score is saved in sealshove.srm next to the exe.
